summary.text: Mollie Sullivan Burke, a Democrat from Brattleboro, has represented Windham-8 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2009.
She serves on the House Committee on Transportation and chairs the House Sexual Harassment Prevention Panel.

paragraphs.text: Burke grew up in Buffalo, New York, and on the Niagara River in Canada, the eldest in a family of eleven children, according to her House biography.
She earned an undergraduate degree in Political Science, did graduate study at the London School of Economics, and received a Master of Fine Arts from Goddard College.
She is founder and director of Art in the Neighborhood, which provides tuition-free art classes to children in low-income housing communities.
She is a Brattleboro Town Meeting representative and is active in the Climate Solutions Caucus and the Women's Caucus.
